ns2:course.label: Adv Tech Based Mus Instruction
ns2:course.description: Continuation (in greater depth) of topics introduced in MUS 447. Special attention to the application of multimedia and MIDI technologies in the development of advanced class projects. Creation of HTML resources with music education applications on the Internet. Higher credit will require a major project and paper using multimedia technology and/or Internet resources. Prerequisite: MUS 447; graduate standing, or consent of instructor.
